# MacOS Theme
__For Raspberry Pi's running Bookworm or newer__
> [!WARNING]
> You need an active cooler / any cooler to proceed!

> [!NOTE]
> This only supports a RaspberryPi without a Monitor!

__Have a RasberryPi with a monitor?__

[Click here for the monitor version!](https://github.com/vector-just-technology/MacOS-Theme/tree/monitor-support)
### Installation Process
```
# Copy and paste this whole block
sudo apt upgrade

# 1. Clone the GitHub repository
git clone https://github.com

# 2. Move into the project folder
cd MacOS-Theme

# 3. Grant execute permissions to the installer script
chmod +x install.sh

# 4. Run the installer script
./install.sh

```
__If there is an error, you may not have git__
```
sudo apt upgrade && sudo apt install git
```

### Flexibility

__There are two options__

1. You have no displays, configure wifi and ssh / or RaspberryPi Connect, and install the Headless version
2. You have a display, you can install the normal Display-Enabled Version.

### Features

- MacOS Inspired Design
- Overclocking
> [!WARNING]
> Overclocking the CPU on a Raspberry Pi 4 is limited. If you have a Raspberry Pi 5, overclocking is set to 2.8GHZ to be safe.
